تستحسنين (form X)
# تَسْتَحْسِنِينَ (tastaḥsinīna) /tas.taħ.si.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْسَنَ (istaḥsana)
# تُسْتَحْسَنِينَ (tustaḥsanīna) /tus.taħ.sa.niː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْسَنَ (istaḥsana)
